item.title: The Chosen
item.description: An executive at a nuclear power plant discovers that his son is the Antichrist.

item.title: The Fury
item.description: A desperate father searches for his psychic son, who's been kidnapped by a rogue government agent.

item.title: Love and Bullets
item.description: An Arizona cop is sent to Switzerland to bring in the girlfriend of a dangerous mobster so she can testify against him.

item.title: The Sicilian Clan
item.description: After a murderer escapes from prison with the help of his Sicilian mobster buddy, the duo teams up with an American thief who has crafted a scheme to hijack an airplane transporting jewels from Venice to New York City.

item.title: Murder, Inc.
item.description: A young couple struggles to escape the syndicate which has a contract out on them.

item.title: Capone
item.description: This searing crime drama details the life of Al Capone, who began his rise through the underworld at age 11, eventually becoming one of Chicago's most notorious gangsters.

item.title: The St. Valentine's Day Massacre
item.description: Rival Chicago mobsters Al Capone and Bugs Moran battle for control of Chicago organized crime, culminating in a bloody Valentine's Day massacre in which Capone's men, dressed as police, kill seven key members of Moran's gang in a warehouse.

item.title: Impact
item.description: A wealthy industrialist assumed dead returns for revenge against his wife and her lover.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: Ralph Phillips imagination in class sends him off into space where he embarks on a great adventure that includes a climactic battle with Martians.

item.title: Fractured Flickers
item.description: Hans Conried and celebrity guests present dubbed over silent picture film clips.
